answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The harbor edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 64 clones produces a signature the ridge analysis flags immediately. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the willow settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
